Updated the main page to conditionally show buttons based on login status.

## Changes Made:

1. **`app/page.tsx`**:
   - Added server-side authentication check using the Supabase server client
   - If logged in: shows a button "přejít do Tappky" that links to `/dashboard`
   - If not logged in: shows the login form

2. **`components/google-login-button.tsx`**:
   - Changed button text from "Continue with Google" to "Přihlásit se přes google"
   - Changed loading text from "Connecting..." to "Připojování..."

3. **`components/login-form.tsx`**:
   - Updated card title from "Sign in" to "Přihlášení"
   - Updated description to Czech: "Přihlaste se pomocí svého Google účtu"

The main page now:
- Shows "přejít do Tappky" button for logged-in users (links to dashboard)
- Shows "Přihlásit se přes google" button for logged-out users (triggers Google OAuth)

All text is in Czech, and the implementation uses server-side authentication checks for security.
